name: ZZF burnToHolder pays BNB at a live spot quote
summary: ZZF.burnToHolder prices the ZongZi a user burns with uniswapRouter.getAmountsOut against WBNB and has the ZongZi token pay that many BNB from its reward pool into ZZF, from which receiveRewards pays the burner. After flash-loan buys pumped the WBNB/ZongZi pair, the attacker burned ZongZi at the inflated spot quote and withdrew nearly all of the pool's BNB in two transactions.
notes: setMainToken pointed ZZF's _burnToken at the ZongZi token, whose BNB pool it prices and pays from.

BNB depletion of the ZongZi reward pool across both attacker transactions. The attacker's flash-loan buys left about 656 more WBNB in the WBNB/ZongZi pair, which is not netted; the reported ~$223k is the attacker's net profit after that pump. A 4.32 BNB claim by 0xb89b232238b1bad9f144443960f600ea51cb0418 later in the block is not counted.
